pages.text: This boss has no structure, his house is an empty End.$(br)To summon him, you need to create a Larva of a crimson mosquito.

pages.title: Larva
pages.text: This is one of the stages of summoning a worm.$(br2)After that, you will need a Capsid that drops from the Endophages, which appears in the wastelands of the End.
Place the Capsid, RMB on it with the Larva in your hand. There will be a transmutation and at the exit we will get a Mysterious Worm.$(br2)It needs to be dropped into the void to lure the Void Worm.

All information about the boss is written in a Book about animals.$(br2)The worm of the void can only be difficult because it can teleport through space and split into parts. With good armor and weapons, he won't cause you any problems.
